message.reasoning:
We have to decide post-turn action. Player p1 (Alpha) has cash 65, holdings: Reading Railroad (unmortgaged), Oriental Ave 2 houses, Vermont Ave 2 houses, Connecticut Ave 2 houses, Electric Company. Buildable spaces: those three with 2 houses each. Can build more houses? Need to follow even building rule: must build evenly across color set. Currently each has 2 houses. To build further, need to add one house to each before any gets a third. So need 3 houses total (one each) costing? Oriental, Vermont, Connecticut are each in the light blue set. House cost for light blue is $50 each (standard Monopoly). So building one house on each would cost $150, which exceeds cash 65. So cannot build houses.

Can mortgage property: mortgageable keys: Electric Company, Reading Railroad. Mortgage values: Electric Company mortgage value $75? Actually utility mortgage is $75. Reading Railroad mortgage $100. Mortgaging would give cash but also reduce rent. Cash 65, need maybe to get more cash for future. Could also consider selling building? Sellable_building_space_keys same three. Selling a house returns half cost: $25 each. Could sell houses to raise cash. Currently have 2 houses each, total 6 houses. Could sell one house from each? Must sell evenly: can sell houses evenly across set. So can sell one house from each, reducing each to 1 house, gaining $75 total (3*25). That would bring cash to 140. Then could maybe build later. But selling houses reduces rent, but maybe okay.

We need to choose one action now. Options: build_houses_or_hotel, mortgage_property, end_turn. Also could sell building? Actually sellable_building_space_keys is listed, but there is no explicit "sell_building" action; maybe building houses/hotel includes selling? The tool "build_houses_or_hotel" likely can also sell? Not sure. The schema: build_houses_or_hotel takes build_plan with count, kind, space_key. Probably only building, not selling. So selling houses may not be an option. So only mortgage or end turn.

We have cash 65, low. Might want to mortgage a property to increase cash for future building or to avoid bankruptcy. Mortgage Reading Railroad gives $100, raising cash to 165. That seems good. However, mortgaging reduces rent from opponents landing there. Opponents: Beta at Illinois Avenue, Gamma at Boardwalk, Delta at B&O Railroad. B&O is another railroad, so reading railroad is not heavily landed. Mortgage is okay.

Alternatively mortgage Electric Company for $75, cash becomes 140. Both give cash. Which is better? Reading Railroad mortgage gives more cash. Also Electric Company could be useful later for utility rent, but less important. I'd mortgage Reading Railroad.

Public message: could say "I'll mortgage my Reading Railroad to raise cash." Might be used for negotiation. Keep concise.

Make tool call mortgage_property with space_key "READING_RAILROAD". Provide private and public messages.
